Name: Common Message Registry
Description: This registry defines the Common messages for Redfish

IgnorePowerControlRequest.Description: Indicates system power state has been switched off
IgnorePowerControlRequest.Message: Ignore power control request because of power has been switched off

PropertyInvalidCondition.Description: Indicates that the property in a PATCH or POST is not valid in the current state
PropertyInvalidCondition.Message: Property %1 is not valid in the current state: %2
PropertyInvalidCondition.Resolution: Correct the value for the property in the request body and resubmit the request if the operation failed.

PropertyValueTypeMismatch.Description: Indicates that the data type for the property is unexpected.
PropertyValueTypeMismatch.Message: Invalid data type for property %1; Expected a value of type %2.
PropertyValueTypeMismatch.Resolution: Correct the value for the property in the request body and resubmit the request if the operation failed.

PropertyUpdateFailed.Description: Indicates that the property failed to update. The values may be invalid or an internal error may have occurred.
PropertyUpdateFailed.Resolution: Verify that the value for the property is valid and resubmit the request. Other properties may have updated.

CertificateUriMismatch.Description: Indicates that the CertificateUri is invalid.
CertificateUriMismatch.Resolution: Confirm that the resource of uri is existed or replacement is not allowed.

ServiceDisabled.Description: Indicates that the Service is disabled.
ServiceDisabled.Message: The operation failed because the service is disabled and can no longer take incoming requests.
ServiceDisabled.Resolution: When the service is enabled, resubmit the request if the operation failed.

InvalidKeyLength.Description: The minimum key length is 2048 bits.
InvalidKeyLength.Message: The minimum key length is 2048 bits.
InvalidKeyLength.Resolution: Confirm the key length is 2048 bits or greater, and resubmit the request.
